meta.grounding: VizSpec 2.1.0; scoped art direction overrides the engine travel/apparel match. Neutral chassis inherits preset 02; template colors remain registered in their own DNA.

design_read: Independent travel storefront design directory for agencies and product teams; warm editorial interface gallery.

logo_context.policy: Reuse the ten supplied template logos; retain the existing Ortasys textual identity, do not invent a new corporate mark.

typography.heading_usage: Manrope for the main statement with a contrasting italic DM Serif phrase; DM Serif for the closing statement.

section_order: Asymmetric editorial intro with supplied FigCraft preview composition
Ten-preset interface collection with independent document links
Shared S4 contract and closing index

motion.scroll: One-time viewport reveals; no scroll hijacking
motion.hover: Preview pan, bezel lift and 4px arrow translation
motion.ambient: Gentle preview-window float only for no-preference users
motion.accessibility: Disable animation/transforms for prefers-reduced-motion; all content visible without JavaScript

assets.source: Existing template logos and D01 FigCraft exports. No replacement imagery or brand assets generated.
assets.previews: catalogue-assets/preview-01.webp through preview-10.webp; cropped and compressed from supplied previews/D01.png

constraints: All 40 existing relative document links remain unchanged.
The root is an optional catalogue, never a router required by the ten storefronts.
Booking and checkout remain local simulations.
Template folders and FigCraft source remain unchanged.
